objective: Record the reviewed-direction A design and acceptance contract for two independent actor-owned workspaces, a bounded persistent read-only job queue with recovery, and automatic read-only production snapshot ingestion; deliver specifications only in this stage.
non_goals: No product implementation before written specification and implementation-plan review.
No existing service replacement, merge, push, production sync, collection, model calls, registration, ACL changes, new member grants or cloud resources.
No administrative whitelist UI or new research engine in this batch.
reviewer: Junyan written specification review; later independent code reviewer
dependencies: Final integration must be verified on current main containing parent changes
forbidden_scope: Existing serving workbench worktrees and isolated state
Product Python/React code, CI workflows, mutation manifest and production ledgers in this specification stage
input_contracts: Junyan approved central execution with independent outputs, shared query, read-only automatic production input sync and one formal production writer.
Source reads inspect the fixed existing workbench code; no production files are read for specification creation.
Baselines and actual test results must not be treated as acceptance of the unimplemented new design.
output_artifacts: Versioned design and acceptance checklist with NOT_RUN new-feature status
Compiled ai-task.v1 result and local baseline evidence outside tracked files
Exact-file documentation commit on the isolated specification branch; no push or PR in this stage
acceptance_tests: git diff --check and verify that only the three declared specification files are changed

Self-review verifies identity, source/attempt separation, immutable input binding, each crash write point, migration, capacity bounds, unchanged production authority and actual two-computer acceptance requirements
approval_gates: Conversation direction approved; written specification is REVIEW_REQUIRED before implementation planning.
Written implementation plan and execution method require review before product changes.
Merge, shared runtime cutover and formal production authority are separate gates; none inferred from access identity.
